name: I CAN'T CUM UNLESS I GET THROW LOOPED
source:
A yuri kinetic novel about fighting games and frustration, both sexual and otherwise. For fans of fighting games, women, or just anyone who has ever questioned why they love their hobbies.

Created start-to-finish by Team LDCLLL in about six weeks for 2026's TOXIC YURI VN JAM 2.

Features:

    A little under 10k words (about an hour's worth of reading) of miserably-competitive lesbians, and their love/hate relationship with both each other and a video game
    An original soundtrack
    An extensive amount of fighting game terminology
    A glossary for the above-mentioned fighting game terminology
    A tiny bit of voice acting
    An accessibility option to switch the font to OpenDyslexic
    Fight stick clicking noises


While I Can't Cum Unless I Get Throw Looped has no nudity and is not explicitly pornographic, this visual novel still contains an extensive amount of sexual themes and should not be played in the workplace or by anyone under eighteen years of age.
translation:
一部关于格斗游戏和挫折的尤里动力学小说，包括性方面的和其他方面的。适合格斗游戏迷、女性或任何曾经质疑过自己为何热爱自己的爱好的人。

LDCLLL团队为2026年的TOXIC YURI VN JAM 2从头到尾创作了大约六周的时间。

特点：

    不到一万字（大约一个小时的阅读量），讲述了竞争激烈的女同性恋者，以及她们彼此之间和电子游戏的爱/恨关系
    原创配乐
    大量的格斗游戏术语
    上述格斗游戏术语表
    一点点配音
    将字体切换为OpenDyslexic的辅助功能选项
    战斗棒点击声


虽然《我不能射，除非我被扔掉》没有裸露内容，也没有明显的色情内容，但这部视觉小说仍然包含大量的性主题，不应该在工作场所或任何十八岁以下的人玩。
